title: Ring proper/open refinement with its integral scalar square
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l different from its characteristic, finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y, and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X to Y. Let R be CoefficientConstructionRing, with every left realization shift compatible [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-assembly-data]. For any proper compactification refinement r:c to d there is a family alpha_s:(R.operation c s).F isomorphic to (R.operation d s).F at finite and integral ring stages. Every alpha_s preserves shifts and has the specified open-unit/proper-compositor normalization RingRefinementNormalized. For every finite coefficient-field extension E to L the integral family satisfies TY(alpha_E) followed by q_d equals q_c followed by alpha_L(TX(-)), for the specified completed scalars and q maps of R. No rational or closed refinement is asserted.

source.place: Section 5, Lemma 5.13 and Constructions 5.14--5.15; normalized refinement construction step 6.

proof.text: Choose the natural normalized open-unit comparison at each ring stage. Form beta by the explicit inverse proper compositor and proper pushforward of its inverse. Conjugate beta by R.left and lift the resulting natural isomorphism through the fully faithful output inclusion.

Reflect shift compatibility through the faithful inclusion. The assumed shift-compatible realizations, their inverses and beta commute with shifts, hence so does the lifted alpha. Substitution and cancellation give RingRefinementNormalized with the chosen open-unit components.

Apply the ordinary scalar-refinement square to the lifted scalar object using its realization isomorphism as the vertex transport e. Map the desired exceptional scalar equation into the ordinary category and cancel the output realization followed by the image of e. Use scalar-realization naturality, the two comparison_normalized equations and the formula for the lifted alpha. The remaining terms cancel by the inverse identities of e and R.left.

proof_origin.place: Explicit full-subcategory lifting, faithful shift reflection and a calculation conjugating the ordinary scalar word by R.left and the scalar realizations. The geometric open-unit and ordinary scalar-word steps are split off separately.
